text: Duration of study: 1-4 weeks(20hours/week) A. Class schedule: Morning class: 08:00 - 12:00 from Monday to Friday. 4 class hours per day and 20 class hours per week. B. Class grouping: Three levels class as elementary Chinese, intermediate Chinese and senior Chinese. After registration, all students will take the entrance examination to decide your class level. Each class has 15 students. C. Chinese teaching: Compulsory course including reading, speaking, pronunciation, etc. Optional course including Chinese folk, translation, writing, news and reading, ancient Chinese and so on. Aiming to improve students' practicing Chinese in listening, speaking, reading and writing. After registration, students will get the student card and when finishing the whole class, they will get the certificate and transcript inssued by NENU. Tuition CNY 1200 for one week CNY 1600 for two weeks CNY 2000 for three weeks CNY 600 each additional week above 4 weeks. Accommodation A. Single room: CNY 35 per bed per day. Facilities: Telephone, Internet, TV set, independent bathroom and toilet. B. Double room: CNY 35 per bed per day. Facilities: Telephone, Internet, TV set, independent bathroom and toilet.
